verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch verification, bulk screening or mass case actions, are a fair question for a compliance platform, but the evidence pack never documents running an operation across many items at once. The closest items describe ongoing automatic re-screening and per-case auto-decisioning. Those are continuous monitoring and per-item automation, not user-initiated bulk actions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
